title: •No Disintegrations!
caption: •No Disintegrations! (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During opponent’s turn, may place a just forfeited Rebel of ability > 2 out of play; opponent loses 3 Force.
lore: “There will be a substantial reward for the one who finds the _Millennium Falcon_. You are free to use any methods necessary, but I want them alive.”
